scope: Corollary 4.5 of the manuscript “Deterministic Polynomial Factorization over Prime Fields” (preprints/Deterministic-Polynomial-Factorization-over-Prime-Fields-October-4-2026/Deterministic-Polynomial-Factorization-over-Prime-Fields.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 142 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ed88aa5ba802311a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the setup of Section 4.1, let r ≥ 0, m = 1 + (q − 1)r, and [k : K] = qr. For every i there exist classes di,1, . . . , di,m, all represented by degree-zero divisors over k, such that di,1 = [Pi − ∞0], λdi,t+1 = di,t (1 ≤ t < m), λt di,t = [e] (1 ≤ t ≤ m). (4.11) Moreover, every successive choice of a geometric division in such a chain has a representative over k.
